title: ExternalLocation

url.description: Link to the file, or to a shared folder that holds it. It may grant access; treat it as private.

path.description: The file's path inside the shared folder at `url`, using `/` between folders.

reference.description: Provider's file ID, when the link and path do not identify the file.

description:
A file shared outside the API: a calibrated sub or a stacked master. Visible only to the
submitter and reviewing maintainers. Many subs can share one folder link, each naming
its file with `path`.
